subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw add a dedicated `/models test-fallback` command now, or fold fallback-chain verification into broader configured-model health and staged model migration work?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested command adds a new live provider/auth diagnostic surface that overlaps open model-health and model-migration feature requests.

options.title: Sponsor Narrow Fallback Probe
options.body: Add a first-class command that intentionally starts at configured fallback candidates, supports first/all modes, and reports which fallback model answered while reusing runtime fallback/auth resolution.

options.title: Fold Into Model Health
options.body: Track fallback-chain verification under configured-model health checks so users get one canonical diagnostic path instead of parallel probe commands.

options.title: Defer Core Command
options.body: Leave current status/auth probes and fallback management unchanged until maintainers choose the broader model migration UX.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Narrow Fallback Probe
recommendation.body: Add a first-class command that intentionally starts at configured fallback candidates, supports first/all modes, and reports which fallback model answered while reusing runtime fallback/auth resolution.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided the clearest product-scope review on this issue and has adjacent history in fallback/status behavior.
